articles.title: 'Oil's' well in September: How India kept crude flowing amid the energy crisis
articles.summary: September marked a significant high in India's crude oil imports, mainly spurred by boosted supplies from Gulf nations. The reintroduction of Iraqi and Kuwaiti crude has notably changed the dynamics of India's import sources, ensuring better supply availability.

articles.title: UPI transactions rise 27% to 145 billion in H1 FY27 ahead of new MDR
articles.summary: UPI has recorded significant transaction growth, processing 145 billion transactions in the first half of the financial year. The value of these transactions increased to Rs 177 lakh crore, reflecting a notable rise.

articles.title: 'No amount of money can ever...': Mankind Pharma honours flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar with ₹1 crore
articles.summary: Machchhar was stabbed and seriously injured by his co-pilot in the cockpit of Flydubai flight FZ1073 while the aircraft was flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv on Wednesday.

articles.title: G7’s 100-million-barrel diesel fix: What happens after the emergency release
articles.summary: The G7 announced an urgent release of 100 million barrels of oil and fuel products to counteract the ongoing diesel shortages, starting now and extending over the upcoming four months.

articles.title: Petrol, diesel prices today (October 3): Check latest rates in Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata & more
articles.summary: While international crude continues its upward trajectory, retail prices for petrol, diesel, and LPG have not been adjusted, leaving state refiners to absorb the full impact of the price surge.

articles.title: Irdai plan to help check mis-selling, raise returns
articles.summary: Irdai has introduced proposed guidelines aimed at reshaping the commission and expense structures for insurance distribution. This shift focuses on reducing reliance on high commission models, favoring a more customer-oriented strategy.

articles.title: Sea of red for most asset classes
₹1.50 lakh gold tests Indian consumers: Lightweight jewellery gains traction
articles.summary: Gold’s recent correction could offer a buying window ahead of Diwali and the wedding season, but prices near ₹1.50 lakh per 10 grams remain a concern.

articles.title: ₹4,69,000 EVs this Diwali? 5 electric cars get massive price cuts, but there’s a catch
articles.summary: Five EVs are being offered at lower upfront prices through Battery-as-a-Service this Diwali, with savings of up to ₹7.04 lakh. But buyers still pay a per-km battery rental.

articles.title: CNG drivers, check this before your next refill: IGL’s new system can flag your car at the pump
articles.summary: IGL’s new CNG verification system can scan a vehicle’s registration number and check its cylinder hydro-test record before refuelling, potentially blocking cars with expired safety certificates.

articles.title: Oil shock bypasses petrol pumps, hits Indian businesses through raw-material costs
articles.summary: India’s oil shock is increasingly showing up in industrial input costs rather than at petrol pumps, with several raw materials seeing sharp price increases. IndiaMART data shows PP granules rose 32% between July and September, highlighting mounting pressure on businesses.

articles.title: India’s GST revenue growth has lost momentum: What the post-2025 data shows
articles.summary: India’s GST collections remain robust in absolute terms, but the pace of revenue growth has slowed sharply from FY23 levels, top economists said.

articles.title: Father got 3 bigha in 1972; HC protects married daughter's land claim after parents death
articles.summary: In 1972, the Himachal Pradesh government allotted three bigha and two biswas of agricultural land in Shimla to a person under the Nautor rules for cultivation.

articles.title: ‘Workers growing increasingly anxious’: US adds 29k jobs, far below 90k expected
articles.summary: US employers added only 29,000 jobs in September, significantly lower than economists' expectations of 90,000. The unemployment rate rose to 4.2% as more people entered the workforce without immediate jobs.

articles.title: Gold's Rs 1.5 lakh price drives buyers to silver who get 650g silver at same price
articles.summary: At current prices, 10 grams of 24-karat gold costs around Rs 1.5 lakh, an amount that would buy approximately 650 grams of silver. With gold prices remaining prohibitively high for a large section of middle-class buyers, the white metal is steadily attracting attention.

articles.title: GST collections may look stronger than they are: What rate re-labelling is hiding
articles.summary: GST rate changes since September 2025 have simplified the tax structure, but changes in revenue classification may be masking a weaker underlying revenue trend, top economists said.

articles.title: Can technology make farming a career choice for young Indians? Anant Ambani’s four-point plan
articles.summary: Reliance Industries executive director Anant Ambani has outlined a four-point plan to make agriculture more attractive to young Indians, combining digital tools, skills, entrepreneurship and village-level opportunities.

articles.title: ICICI Life appoints Sidharatha Mishra as MD & CEO as Anup Bagchi steps down
articles.summary: Mishra’s appointment as MD and CEO will take effect from October 14, 2026, or the date on which the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) grants its approval, whichever is later, the company said in an exchange filing.

articles.title: Reliance plans ₹1 lakh crore CBG investment in Andhra Pradesh, eyes 3 lakh jobs
articles.summary: Reliance Industries is stepping up its clean-energy push in Andhra Pradesh with a proposed ₹1 lakh crore investment in compressed biogas plants. The projects are expected to create more than 3 lakh jobs while supporting the state’s energy and rural economy.

articles.title: ACKO launches DriveCam, Clinic and AirPass to expand insurance beyond claims
articles.summary: The new products span motor, health, travel and everyday safety, with the company positioning them around a common approach of protecting customers before something goes wrong

articles.title: India’s FDI treaties fell from 73 to 8: What happened after the 2016 Model BIT?
articles.summary: India’s investment treaty network fell from 73 treaties in force in 2015 to eight by 2021, economist Surjit Bhalla has highlighted while calling for a rethink of the 2016 Model BIT.

articles.title: September shipments through Hormuz hit post-war high as LNG cargoes pick up
articles.summary: The month of September marked a significant spike in LNG traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, with 19 to 21 cargoes navigating the waters, the highest since war broke out. The cargoes predominantly hailed from Qatar and the United Arab Emirates.

articles.title: If Trump imposes tariffs, will buying crude from Russia make economic sense for India?
articles.summary: Russia became an unusually attractive supplier when Western buyers retreated after the war with Ukraine. Its share of Indian crude imports, below 2% before the war, expanded rapidly as discounts compensated refiners for longer supply chains.

articles.title: Nike restructuring plan: World's largest footwear major announces job cuts, targets $2.5 billion savings
articles.summary: The restructuring, called “Pace”, will include changes to Nike’s organisational structure, supply chain and global operating model. It is yet to disclose how many employees will be affected.

articles.title: Why $143.5-billion FCNR inflows may not mean abundant bank liquidity
articles.summary: Record foreign-currency inflows have lifted bank deposits, but SBI Research says the liquidity impact may be far smaller than the headline numbers suggest.

articles.title: A costly bite: Global food prices rise to their highest level in nearly four years
articles.summary: In a concerning trend, global food prices have surged to their highest point in nearly four years, driven by disruptions in trade and adverse weather conditions.

articles.title: Historic milestone: Watch Vande Bharat cross Chenab bridge, Anji bridges at 100 kmph
articles.summary: The higher speed of 100 kmph was successfully put to the test today, according to Railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw. Vande Bharat Express (Train No.

articles.title: Vedanta wants to boost crude output from Rajasthan oil fields; plans $200 million investment: Report
articles.summary: The company plans to achieve this increase through enhanced recovery techniques such as polymer flooding, well interventions and alkaline-surfactant-polymer injection.

articles.title: Rupee near 97: Rupee faces multi-front pressure; SBI Research calls for immediate protective measures
articles.summary: The rupee is facing multi-front pressure from FPI outflows, stronger dollar demand and a sharp rise in global bond yields, with the currency nearing the 97-per-dollar mark.

articles.title: Gold gets its festive shine back as lower prices lure Asian buyers
articles.summary: Recent declines in gold prices in India have sparked greater interest among physical buyers, leading to reduced discounts from sellers. With the festival season on the horizon, demand is likely to surge, particularly for jewelry.

articles.title: ‘Don’t cut salaries’: Govt’s clear directive to companies as EPF wage ceiling rises
articles.summary: On September 17, the government increased the EPFO wage threshold from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000. The revision is expected to extend mandatory coverage to more than 10 million additional workers and give another push to workforce formalisation.

articles.title: Eli Lilly CEO Dave Ricks sees bigger India role in global drug innovation
articles.summary: As Lilly expands its India business in areas including obesity and cardiometabolic health, Ricks says the country can play a bigger role in discovering, developing and scaling medicines for global markets.

articles.title: Property value rose before registration; ITAT scraps Rs 11.35 lakh tax on buyer
articles.summary: Under Section 56(2)(x), there is applicable taxation of such a difference in the buyer's hands if the stamp duty value of the property is higher than the purchase consideration by more than the greater of Rs 50,000 or 10% of the consideration.

articles.title: Flydubai incident raises a question: Should cockpit doors be locked from inside?
articles.summary: Flydubai incident: Captain Smit Machchhar, despite being wounded, resisted the attacker and ensured that help from the cabin could reach the cockpit by making sure the doors could be breached.

articles.title: Dollar hits 17-month high: Greenback headed for three week gaining streak as bond rout drags euro
articles.summary: The US dollar has reached a 17-month high as it benefits from a global bond sell-off. Concerns regarding France’s fiscal stability have adversely affected the euro's value against the dollar.

articles.title: Gandhi Jayanti: Are NSE, BSE closed for trading on October 2?
articles.summary: Stock trading will be halted on October 2, 2026, in observance of Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti. Both the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange will be closed for the day, along with the Multi Commodity Exchange.

articles.title: Identified the items but India-US trade deal not imminent, says USTR Jamieson Greer
articles.summary: Jamieson Greer said he had a “very constructive conversation” with Goyal at the G20 ​trade ministers meeting ​in Milwaukee, and also added that the officials from both sides are continuing the conversation.

articles.title: India-US trade deal not imminent, PM Modi-Trump may hold another call soon: US trade rep
articles.summary: India and the US are nearing the final stages of a significant trade agreement, with expectations of its announcement imminent. US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer revealed that teams are actively working through residual challenges.

articles.title: Oil prices soar to $103 per barrel again as Middle East supply concerns intensify
articles.summary: Recent developments have led to a surge in oil prices, largely driven by new restrictions placed on Chinese fuel exports. This, combined with reports of increased US military presence in the Middle East, has heightened concerns over supply stability.

articles.title: RBI eases rules for DIIs to buy bank shares
